items.title: Pete Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I know some players that just are marvelous... I remember Al Vizzutti... What a wonderful guy and what a tremendous player... I said, 'You know there’s a guy by the name of Alan Vizzutti, he’s just phenomenal.'

ctx.x: But the degree of professionalism you’ve been able to keep over the years, I have to commend you for that.

I know. Well thank you. I’ve been very lucky. I’ve been in the right places. I know some players that just are marvelous, some of these stage bands, really. I remember Al Vizzutti, you know Vizzutti? © Fillius Jazz Archive -18-
